name: Matt Letscher
bio: Matt Letscher (born 26 June 1970, Grosse Pointe, Michigan, USA) is an American actor, director, and playwright. He is best known as Captain Harrison Love in The Mask of Zorro (1998, Blockbuster Entertainment Award-nominated) and Eobard Thawne / Reverse-Flash in The Flash (2015–2016) and Legends of Tomorrow (2016–2017). In film, he has appeared in Her (2013, dir. Spike Jonze), Identity (2003), Gods and Generals (2003), and 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi (2016). On television he had recurring roles on Scandal (2012), The Carrie Diaries (2013–2014), Good Morning, Miami (2002–2004), and Entourage (2004–2011). He is married to Jennifer Letscher (m. 1998); they have two children. His brother is actor Brian Letscher.
